title: Card 1: seat dekhna aur book karna ek hi UPDATE query me (sirf khaali ho to). 1 row = jeeta, 0 row = 'seat gayi'

callouts.red: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE se pehle taala, phir likho?
callouts.green: Chalta, par DB ke do chakkar aur taala lamba. Ek query me taala chhota
Haarne wala dobara koshish karta. Yahan seedha bolo "seat gayi"

callouts.red: Arpan ne 4 seat li, A4 pehle hi ja chuki
callouts.green: 4 row nahi badli to sab ulta (ROLLBACK). Chaaron ek transaction me

callouts.red: Do log ulte kram me 4-4 seat le rahe, dono atke
callouts.green: DB ye ghera (deadlock) pakad ke ek ko rok deta, wo dobara koshish kare. Seat hamesha ek hi kram me lo (seat_id se)

callouts.red: Network toota? Booking me pakka sahi chahiye (shak ho to mana). Seat list 2 sec purani bhi chalegi.
callouts.green: Seat ki row show banate hi ban jaati, booking sirf UPDATE. Ravi ne phir dabaya? Phir 0 row

kyun: "Seat khaali hai?" aur "book karo" ek hi UPDATE me (WHERE status = khaali). DB row pe taala lagata, ek-ek ko chalata: Arpan pehle gaya (1 row = mili), Ravi ko 0 row = "seat gayi"
peeche: shuru: pehle seat dekho, phir book karo (do kadam)
ab: Arpan aur Ravi ne ek hi second me A1 book ki, dono ko mil gayi
agla: ab seat ek ko mili. Par Arpan ko payment me 3 min lagte (card 2)
